Aktive Mitglieder zählen getrennt, etwa: Active members are counted separately, for example for the association fee per active member and in the development figures; passive members often pay less and take less part in club life. A fine-grained division helps with reporting and fees but takes upkeep if members change often. Follow the constitution or fee regulations, which set out which groups exist and what they pay (§§ 25, 58 no. 2 BGB).
Welche Zeiten zählen für die Mitgliedsda: Which periods count towards length of membership?
Zählt eine Art für die Dauer, fließen ih: If a type counts towards duration, its periods feed into anniversaries and honours. In favour: loyalty is also recognised as a passive member; against: if your honours regulations only count active years. Adopt the rule from the constitution or honours regulations so that honours are calculated the same for everyone (§ 25 BGB).
Welche Mitglieder an den Dachverband mel: Which members to report to the umbrella association?
Gemeldete Mitglieder gibt der Verein mit: The club passes reported members with their data to the umbrella association, which then calculates its fees. Every transfer needs a legal basis and should be limited to what is necessary (Art. 5(1)(c), Art. 6(1) GDPR). Report the types that the umbrella association's constitution requires, and no more.
Kalenderjahr oder abweichendes Geschäfts: Calendar year or different financial year?
Das Kalenderjahr passt zur Steuer, denn: The calendar year suits tax, because corporation tax is assessed by calendar year (§ 7(3) KStG). A different financial year suits clubs whose year follows a season or festival, but may require additional statements for the tax office. What the constitution says is decisive (§ 25 BGB).
Altersstufen oder eigene Mitgliedsart?: Age bands or a separate membership type?
Altersstufen setzen den Beitrag automati: Age bands set the fee automatically by age at the start of the financial year, without you having to change the membership type. A separate membership type such as “Youth” is better if rights or reporting also change with age. Different fees need a basis in the constitution or fee regulations (§ 58 no. 2 BGB).
Jährlich abrechnen spart Arbeit, Porto u: Annual billing saves work, postage and bank charges per direct debit. Half-yearly or quarterly billing splits high fees into smaller amounts but multiplies runs and reminders. The constitution or fee regulations decide (§ 58 no. 2 BGB).
Beitrag bei Eintritt im laufenden Zeitra: Pro rata fee when joining during the period?
Anteilig heißt: Wer im Lauf des Zeitraum: Pro rata means: whoever joins during the period pays per started month. That seems fair and makes joining in autumn easier, but gives odd amounts that need explaining. If the constitution or fee regulations say nothing, the board should decide on a rule and apply it equally to all (§ 58 no. 2 BGB).
Wie lang soll das Zahlungsziel sein?: How long should the payment term be?
Das Zahlungsziel ist die Frist vom Rechn: The payment term is the period from the invoice date to the due date. Without a reminder, a member is in default at the latest 30 days after the due date and receipt of the invoice, but consumers only if the invoice points this out (§ 286(3) BGB). A short term brings the money in sooner but means more reminders; a long term the opposite.
Der QR-Code enthält Empfänger, IBAN, Bet: The QR code contains recipient, IBAN, amount and reference, so members scan it with their banking app instead of typing (EPC069-12). That avoids typos and wrong references; not every banking app reads it. It is worthwhile as soon as members pay by transfer rather than direct debit.
Per Lastschrift kommt der Beitrag pünktl: With direct debit the fee arrives on time and without reminders; for this you need a creditor ID, mandates and a pre-notification. Payers can return a direct debit within eight weeks without giving a reason, which can cost the club bank charges (§ 675x BGB, EPC016-06). The more members pay, the more work direct debit saves; with few, bank transfer is often enough.
Vor jedem Einzug kündigst du Betrag und: Before each collection you announce amount and date, under the SEPA rulebook 14 calendar days in advance unless otherwise agreed (EPC016-06). A shorter period speeds up the run but only applies if it is stated in the mandate or the fee terms. Without such an agreement, use 14 days.
Echte Mitgliedsbeiträge, die alle für de: Genuine membership fees that everyone pays for the club's purpose are not a taxable supply; no VAT belongs on them (UStAE 1.4). You only show tax for services in return for payment, such as sales or advertising, and only if the club is not a small business (§ 19 UStG: previous year up to €25,000, current year up to €100,000). Whoever shows tax without owing it owes it anyway (§ 14c UStG); if in doubt, ask the tax office or a tax adviser.
Wie viele Mahnstufen und welche Gebühr?: How many reminder levels and what charge?
Mehr Stufen geben säumigen Mitgliedern m: More levels give late payers more opportunity but take time and delay expulsion or a court payment order. Charges beyond actual costs such as postage need a basis in the constitution or fee regulations (§§ 280(2), 286, 58 no. 2 BGB). Start with a friendly reminder without a charge and add levels if a lot is still open afterwards.
Gemeinnützige Vereine trennen ideellen B: Non-profit clubs separate the non-profit sphere, asset management, special-purpose operations and commercial operations, because only the last can be taxable (§§ 14, 64, 65 AO). The assignment makes the tax return easier but requires clean categories. Switch it on as soon as the club has income from sales, festivals or advertising; if this stays at or below €50,000 a year including VAT, no corporation or trade tax is due on it (§ 64(3) AO, since 2026; previously €45,000).
Der Anfangsbestand ist der Kontostand am: The opening balance is the account balance on the cut-off date from which you book in HUBIplan, usually the start of the financial year. Take it from the bank statement or the last treasurer's report; an estimated value is quicker but carries through every later report as a difference. The board's duty to account requires a complete statement of income and expenses (§ 259(1) BGB).
Wer vertritt die Einheit nach § 26 BGB?: Who represents the unit under § 26 BGB?
Wer die Einheit nach § 26 BGB vertritt,: Whoever represents the unit under § 26 BGB concludes contracts for it and appears in the register of associations and in the legal notice (§ 5 DDG). Tick this only for roles that the constitution names as the board within the meaning of § 26 BGB, not for the extended board. Many authorised representatives make the club flexible but increase the risk of unwanted obligations.
Jede Berechtigung öffnet Personendaten;: Every permission opens up personal data; grant only what a role needs for its task (Art. 5(1)(f), Art. 25(2) GDPR). Broad rights are convenient when few people do everything, but increase mistakes and damage if sign-in details are lost. Better create one more role, such as “Treasury” without member management, than one catch-all role for everyone.
Das Einzugsdatum muss ein Bankarbeitstag: The collection date must be a bank working day and fall after the pre-notification period (EPC016-06). An early date brings the money in sooner; a date shortly after the start of the month often finds accounts in funds and can save returned debits. Do not collect before the invoices are due.
Was gehört zu einem schriftlichen Mandat: What belongs in a written mandate?
Ein Mandat nennt unter anderem Zahler, I: A mandate states, among other things, payer, IBAN, creditor ID, mandate reference, date and signature (EPC016-06). Keep the original as long as you collect on it, and afterwards as long as queries are possible; without proof, the club must refund a disputed direct debit up to 13 months later (§§ 675u, 676b(2) BGB). HUBIplan stores mandates from the member area itself.
Lastschrift → Mandate → Schriftliches Ma: Direct debit → mandates → record written mandate
Welches Rechnungsdatum für den Beitragsl: Which invoice date for the fee run?
Ab dem Rechnungsdatum läuft das Zahlungs: The payment term, and with it the period until default, runs from the invoice date (§ 286(3) BGB). A date shortly before sending is right; a backdated one shortens the members' term, a late one delays the money coming in.
Per E-Mail ist die Mahnung schnell und k: By email the reminder is quick and free; by letter, receipt is easier to prove. A reminder only takes effect once it is received (§ 130(1), § 286(1) BGB). Email is usually enough for a first reminder; before expulsion or a court payment order a letter is safer.
Ohne Beleg lässt sich eine Buchung bei d: Without a document an entry cannot be proven at the cash audit or to the tax office; the principle is “no entry without a document” (GoBD). Accounting documents must be kept for eight years (§ 147(1) no. 4, (3) AO). Uploading the document straight away with the entry takes a moment but saves searching before the closing.
Abgeschlossenes Jahr sperren, statt es z: Lock a closed year instead of changing it?
Nach dem Abschluss ist das Jahr gesperrt: After closing, the year is locked so that the audited treasurer's report stands and later changes remain visible (§ 146(4) AO). This protects against silent corrections but costs flexibility: you then correct errors with a reversing entry in the current year. Only close once the cash auditors have finished.
Warum nur noch Storno statt Ändern oder: Why only cancellation instead of changing or deleting?
Der ursprüngliche Inhalt einer Buchung m: The original content of an entry must remain ascertainable (§ 146(4) AO), so it is locked once the following month has passed (GoBD) and can only be deleted on the day it was recorded. After that you correct with a cancellation: a reversing entry cancels the wrong one, both remain visible, and you create the correct one anew. This is more laborious but makes every correction traceable for cash auditors and the tax office.
Was prüfen die Kassenprüfer?: What do the cash auditors check?
Kassenprüfer sieht das Gesetz nicht vor;: The law does not provide for cash auditors; the constitution sets their tasks. They usually check whether every entry has a document, whether balances match bank statements and the cash box, and whether expenses are covered by decisions. Their report helps the general meeting decide on discharging the board, which owes an account (§ 27(3), §§ 666, 259 BGB).
Warum die Barkasse regelmäßig zählen, un: Why count the cash box regularly, and with two people?
Die Barkasse muss jederzeit nachprüfbar: The cash box must be verifiable at any time: counted money and cash book should match (§ 146(1) AO). A count record with denominations proves the balance and makes a difference with its reason traceable; a second person protects the treasurer from suspicion but means one more appointment. Count at least at the end of each month and year, and whenever the cash box is handed over.
Warum die Tageseinnahme am Fest rückwärt: Why work out the festival's day's takings backwards?
Ohne Registrierkasse wird nicht jeder Ve: Without a cash register, not every sale is recorded individually; the takings result from closing balance minus float plus expenses paid in cash and withdrawals (open till, § 146(1) AO). This is simple but requires a complete count record at the end, because without it the takings cannot be proven. An electronic till would be more precise but needs a certified security device (§ 146a AO).
Finanzen → Kassenzählung → Kassenbericht: Finance → cash count → festival cash report
Warum braucht das Aufheben eines Abschlu: Why does reopening a closing need a reason?
Ein abgeschlossenes Jahr ist die Grundla: A closed year is the basis for the cash audit and discharge; if it is reopened, it must remain visible what applied before (§ 146(4) AO, GoBD). That is why the old state is kept with reason, person and time, and when closing again you see the differences. Only reopen a closing for real errors, such as a forgotten document, and inform the cash auditors.
Wann dürfen alte Kassendaten weg?: When may old treasury data go?
Belege sind 8 Jahre, Bücher und Abschlüs: Documents must be kept for 8 years, books and closings for 10 years, counted from the end of the calendar year (§ 147(3) and (4) AO); after that data protection requires deleting personal data (Art. 5(1)(e) GDPR). Cleaning up protects former members and donors but is final. Do not clean up while taxes for those years can still be assessed, for example during a tax audit, because the period does not expire until then (§ 147(3) AO).
Wann braucht der Verein eine Rücklage?: When does the club need a reserve?
Ein steuerbegünstigter Verein muss seine: A tax-privileged club must in principle use its funds by the end of the year after next (§ 55(1) no. 5 AO); whoever saves for a project, such as a tent or an anniversary festival, creates a reserve for it (§ 62(1) AO). Reserves make saving traceable but tie up money and need a decision with a purpose. Small clubs below the income limit in § 55(1) no. 5 AO do not have to use funds promptly, but a reserve still helps with planning.
Warum braucht jede Kategorie ein DATEV-K: Why does every category need a DATEV account?
Die Steuerberatung bucht nach einem Kont: The tax adviser books according to a chart of accounts such as SKR 42 or SKR 49; every income and expense must be assigned to a ledger account there, otherwise it ends up in a suspense account and must be rebooked by hand (GoBD). Once assigned cleanly, the export works every year without rework. Agree the accounts with the tax adviser beforehand instead of guessing them.
Wie lange Daten nach dem Austritt behalt: How long to keep data after leaving?
Personendaten dürfen nicht länger gespei: Personal data must not be stored longer than necessary (Art. 5(1)(e), Art. 17(1)(a) GDPR). A short period protects former members, a longer one allows queries, rejoining and honours; invoices and entries stay longer anyway because of tax retention (§ 147 AO). Base the period on possible queries, for example the three-year limitation period (§ 195 BGB).
Personendaten gemeinsam oder je Einheit?: Personal data shared or per unit?
Gemeinsam gepflegt ändert eine Anschrift: Maintained jointly, an address changes everywhere at once, so data stays correct (Art. 5(1)(d) GDPR). In return several units see and change the same data, which requires clear agreements on responsibility (Art. 26 GDPR). Separate copies per unit separate responsibility but lead to diverging versions.
Ein Foto erleichtert das Erkennen am Aus: A photo makes recognition on the ID card easier but shows a person recognisably; for this the club usually relies on their consent (§ 22 KUG, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Consent is voluntary and can be withdrawn at any time, after which the photo must go (Art. 7(3) GDPR). The ID card also works without a photo, so only ask if it really helps.
Wer soll die Dokumente eines Ordners seh: Who should see the documents in a folder?
Je weiter ein Ordner sichtbar ist, desto: The more widely a folder is visible, the more easily members find the constitution and minutes, but the greater the risk that personal data goes too far (Art. 5(1)(c) and (f) GDPR). General items such as the constitution can be widely visible; minutes with names, contracts and lists only for the board. If in doubt, start narrow and widen later.
Öffentliche Termine erreichen Gäste und: Public events reach guests and the press and can be subscribed to as a calendar. Internal events protect place, time and participants, for example for board meetings or youth gatherings (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR). Make public what should be known anyway, and keep everything else internal.
Brauchen wir eine(n) Datenschutzbeauftra: Do we need a data protection officer?
Pflicht ist das, wenn in der Regel minde: It is mandatory if as a rule at least 20 people are constantly engaged in the automated processing of personal data (§ 38(1) BDSG) or the core activity requires it (Art. 37 GDPR). In small clubs this is rarely the case. Appointed voluntarily, a contact person still helps but takes time and expertise.
Jede steuerbegünstigte Körperschaft mit: Any tax-privileged corporation with its own notice, including an unregistered association (§ 10b(1) sentence 2 no. 2 EStG, § 5(1) no. 9 and § 1(1) no. 5 KStG). What matters is the tax office's notice, not the entry in the register of associations. Dependent sub-units such as platoons or departments usually have no notice of their own; the club confirms their donations.
Wie lange trägt der Bescheid des Finanza: How long does the tax office's notice last?
Zuwendungsbestätigungen darf der Verein: The club may only issue donation receipts as long as the exemption notice is at most 5 years old or the determination under § 60a AO at most 3 calendar years old (§ 63(5) AO). After that HUBIplan issues nothing until the new notice is entered. File the tax return in good time so that no donor has to wait for their receipt.
Fördert der Verein vor allem Sport, Heim: If the club mainly promotes sport, local heritage, customs or leisure culture, membership fees are not deductible as donations (§ 10b(1) sentence 8 EStG); this usually applies to marksmen's, sports and carnival clubs. A receipt for them would be incorrect, and the club is liable for the lost tax (§ 10b(4) EStG). Only switch it on if the notice names other purposes, such as youth welfare or monument protection.
Was muss bei einer Sachspende belegt sei: What must be documented for a donation in kind?
Bestätigt wird der Wert der Sache, bei g: The value of the item is confirmed: for used items the market value (gemeiner Wert), for items from a business the withdrawal value (§ 10b(3) sentences 2 and 3 EStG). Describe the item precisely and keep documents on its value, such as a purchase receipt or expert opinion; without them the amount cannot be upheld in an audit. HUBIplan always issues donations in kind individually, never in a collective receipt.
Wann ist ein Verzicht auf Auslagen eine: When is waiving expenses a donation?
Nur wenn ein Anspruch auf Erstattung vor: Only if a claim to reimbursement existed beforehand by contract or constitution and was then waived; the claim must not already have been granted on condition of the waiver (§ 10b(3) sentences 5 and 6 EStG). Travel costs under a club travel expense rule are typical. Without such a rule, the waiver is not a deductible donation.
Wer haftet für eine falsche Bestätigung?: Who is liable for an incorrect receipt?
Wer vorsätzlich oder grob fahrlässig ein: Whoever issues an incorrect receipt intentionally or through gross negligence is liable for the lost tax, a flat 30% of the confirmed amount (§ 10b(4) EStG). The club keeps a duplicate of every receipt (§ 50(7) EStDV); HUBIplan stores the PDF for this. You correct errors by cancelling and issuing anew, not by changing.
Einzeln bestätigen oder einmal zum Jahre: Confirm individually or once at year end?
Die Sammelbestätigung fasst alle Geldzuw: The collective receipt combines all monetary donations of a donor in a calendar year and saves work and postage; the individual receipt comes immediately; both follow the official template (§ 50(1) EStDV). Up to €300 the bank statement together with a document from the club is often enough for the donor (§ 50(4) sentence 1 no. 2 EStDV). Common practice: large donations individually at once, everything else collectively in January.
Nur wenn die Zahlung zu einem umsatzsteu: Only if the payment belongs to a VAT-liable area and the club is not a small business (§ 19 UStG). Whoever shows tax without being entitled to owes it to the tax office anyway (§ 14c(2) UStG). Up to €250 a small-amount invoice with the tax rate instead of the tax amount is enough (§ 33 UStDV).
Wie viel vom Namen zeigt die Webseite?: How much of the name does the website show?
Der volle Name macht Vorstand und Würden: The full name makes board members and title holders clearly identifiable; “First name L.” protects more because search engines find less (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR). For roles with an external function such as the board, the full name is usual. For the chronicle and titles the short form is often enough.
Was zeigt die Webseite ohne Einwilligung: What does the website show without consent?
Namen von Mitgliedern auf einer öffentli: Names of members on a public page need a legal basis, usually their consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). “Omit” is safest; a placeholder keeps lists such as the list of kings complete. You maintain consents and objections in the member record under “Publication”.
Welche Fotos dürfen auf die Webseite?: Which photos may go on the website?
Bilder von erkennbaren Personen brauchen: Pictures of identifiable people need their consent (§ 22 KUG, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Exceptions apply, for example, to pictures of gatherings and parades where the crowd is in the foreground (§ 23(1) no. 3 KUG). If in doubt, use group pictures of public appearances and ask for close-ups.
Sollen Suchmaschinen die Webseite aufneh: Should search engines index the website?
Mit Aufnahme finden Interessierte den Ve: With indexing, interested people find the club via search engines; without it the site can only be reached via its address. In return, names on the site then also appear in search results (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR). Switch it on once the legal notice, privacy policy and name format are right.
Warum holt HUBIplan die Beiträge selbst: Why does HUBIplan fetch the posts itself?
Ein eingebetteter Instagram- oder Facebo: An embedded Instagram or Facebook post sends data to Meta when the page is opened; for this the page would need consent (§ 25 TDDDG), and the club would be jointly responsible (CJEU, C-40/17). HUBIplan therefore fetches the posts itself every 30 minutes and shows them without a connection to Meta. The price: new posts appear with some delay, and each unit needs its own Meta app.
Screenreader lesen ihn blinden Besuchern: Screen readers read it out to blind visitors, and it appears if an image does not load (WCAG 2.2, criterion 1.1.1). Describe in one sentence what can be seen and what of it is important. Pure decoration such as a pattern needs no text.
Namentlich melden oder nur Zahlen?: Report by name or only numbers?
Zahlen reichen für Beiträge und Statisti: Numbers are enough for fees and statistics; the association needs reports by name, for example for honours or eligibility to compete. Names may only be passed on if the constitution or membership of the association provides for it (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and no more than necessary (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR). Also name the association as a recipient in the privacy notice.
Selbst verwaltet arbeiten die Rolleninha: Self-managed, the sub-unit's role holders work with their own accounts and relieve the board above. But every additional account means more people see member data, and someone has to maintain the permissions (Art. 5(1)(f), Art. 32 GDPR). Switch it on if the sub-unit really has its own tasks, such as looking after members or planning events.
Beim eigenen Wettbewerb erfasst ihr Schü: In your own competition you record marksmen and scores yourselves, and HUBIplan calculates places, unit ranking and shoot-offs. In an external one you only enter what the organiser has announced: place and score of your participants. How scoring works there is governed by the organiser's shooting rules (§ 25 BGB).
Wozu Schusszahl und Höchstwert je Schuss: What are number of shots and maximum per shot for?
Mit gewerteten Schüssen und Höchstwert w: With scored shots and a maximum, HUBIplan rejects impossible values when recording, for example 31 with 3 scored shots of at most 10. That way typing errors at the range are noticed before they shift places. The numbers are in the club's shooting rules or the DSB sport regulations.
Wozu Scheibe und Wertungsart?: What are target and scoring type for?
Kennt HUBIplan die Scheibe, rechnet es a: If HUBIplan knows the target, it calculates ring, tenths, inner ten and distance from each hit according to the DSB sport regulations: if the edge of the hole touches the ring line, the higher ring counts. Without recorded hits everything stays as before: you enter the total, and a shoot-off decides ties. The results are internal to the club, not official.
Mit Regeln aus den Treffern entscheidet: With rules based on the hits, HUBIplan decides a tie without a shoot-off, for example under the DSB sport regulations first by the series from the back, then by more tens and more inner tens. This saves time at the range but requires hits to be recorded for everyone tied; otherwise it stays with the shoot-off. Take the order from your shooting rules or the call for entries; if nothing is stated there, the shoot-off remains the usual solution.
Wettbewerb → Einrichten → Einzelwertung: Competition → Setup → Individual ranking → In case of a tie
Warum ist das Foto nur ein Vorschlag?: Why is the photo only a suggestion?
Bei mehreren Löchern ineinander, auf dun: With several holes inside each other, on a dark background or close to a ring line, recognition can be wrong; what counts is the evaluation of the target under the DSB sport regulations or your shooting rules. That is why the photo only places the hits in the tap view, and only “Save” takes them over. The photo itself is only evaluated and never stored, so no image linked to the marksman is created (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR).
Standmodus → Foto der Scheibe: Range mode → Photo of the target
Summe und Foto weichen ab, was gilt?: Total and photo differ, which applies?
Gespeichert wird die eingegebene Summe;: The total entered is what is saved; the photo is only a second opinion that makes typing errors and miscounted rings stand out. If they differ, look at the target again; if in doubt, the supervisor or scorer decides under the DSB sport regulations or your shooting rules. “View hits” shows where recognition sees the holes.
Standmodus → Nur die Summe eingeben → Fo: Range mode → Enter total only → Photo of the target
Echte, bestätigte Scheiben sind der einz: Real, confirmed targets are the only way to check how good photo recognition really is; without them it is only measured on artificial photos. Only the crop of the bullseye with the hit positions is stored, without name, competition or time, so without reference to a person (Art. 4 no. 1 GDPR). Switch it on if you use recognition often; switching off and deleting everything is possible at any time.
Warum zählen nur die besten Schützen ein: Why do only the best marksmen of a unit count?
Mit „Summe der besten 5“ gewinnt ein gro: With “sum of the best 5”, a large platoon does not win merely by having more marksmen, and weak results drag no one down. A platoon with fewer than 5 marksmen is therefore not ranked, otherwise it would be at a disadvantage against full platoons. The DSB sport regulations also rank teams with a fixed number of marksmen.
Nur auf Preisplätzen entscheidet ein Gle: Only on prize places does a tie decide a prize, so HUBIplan only requires a shoot-off there; below them, tied entries share the place. How many places get a prize is in the call for entries. A publicly announced prize is a public promise of reward by which the club is bound (§§ 657, 661 BGB).
Warum die Stechregeln erst beim Anlegen?: Why the shoot-off rules only when creating it?
Ob 1 oder 3 Schuss gestochen werden, ent: Whether 1 or 3 shots are fired in a shoot-off is often decided by the range officer. HUBIplan suggests the rule from “Setup”; changing it is possible until the first score is entered, otherwise the conditions would change in the middle of the shoot-off. For association competitions the DSB sport regulations govern the shoot-off, in the club its own shooting rules.
Wettbewerb → Auswertung oder Standmodus: Competition → Evaluation or range mode → Create shoot-off
HUBIplan erkennt das Ende nicht selbst,: HUBIplan does not detect the end itself, because only the range officer knows about latecomers, absentees and shoot-offs. “Finish shooting” marks the results as provisional; additions and shoot-offs remain possible. Only hand out provisional lists with this note so that nobody takes them as correct and final (Art. 5(1)(d) GDPR).
Wettbewerb → Einrichten → Zustand; Stand: Competition → Setup → Status; range mode → Finish
Was bedeutet endgültig abschließen?: What does closing for good mean?
Danach sind Eingaben gesperrt, und nur e: After that entries are locked, and only final results are intended for the website and honours. Open shoot-offs block the closing, because places would otherwise remain unresolved. Published results must be factually correct (Art. 5(1)(d) GDPR); “Reopen” remains for corrections.
Zurücksetzen löscht alle erfassten Werte: Resetting deletes all recorded scores, shoot-offs, shots and fallen prizes; rules, prizes, range access and event remain. Tablets that still have old entries stored without reception discard them at the next sync. Whether a round is repeated is governed by the shooting rules (§ 25 BGB); it cannot be undone.
Warum ein Standzugang statt Anmeldung?: Why range access instead of signing in?
Ein geliehenes Tablet bekommt einen eige: A borrowed tablet gets its own key that can only record this competition and expires at the end of the competition day. That way nobody enters their password on someone else's device, and the tablet only sees name and sub-unit (Art. 5(1)(c), Art. 32 GDPR). If a device is lost, end the access immediately.
Wettbewerb → Erfassen → Anderes Gerät pe: Competition → Record → Other device via QR code
Wozu „Lose im Hut“?: What is “lots in the hat” for?
Ohne diese Angabe zieht „Nummer ziehen“: Without this, “Draw number” only draws up to the number of marksmen so far, and a latecomer usually gets the next number. With the number of lots in the hat, HUBIplan draws as if from a real hat; if you prefer to draw for everyone at once, use “Draw all without number”. How the order is decided is governed by the shooting rules (§ 25 BGB).
Scheidet aus, wer ein Pfand errungen hat: If whoever has won a prize drops out, more marksmen get a prize. In fixed order, prize after prize is shot, and HUBIplan offers the next one right after each hit. Which rule applies is in the club's shooting rules (§ 25 BGB).
Namen mit Ergebnissen zu zeigen stützt s: Showing names with results usually relies on the club's legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); members can object (Art. 21 GDPR), and for minors ask the parents. For photos of the winners §§ 22 and 23 KUG also apply. “After closing” only shows checked results, “live” also interim standings.
Gruppe von Mitgliedern mit gleichen Rege: Group of members with the same rules, such as “active”, “passive” or “youth”. It determines the fee, reporting to the umbrella association and whether the time counts towards length of membership (§ 58 no. 2 BGB).
Beispiel: „Passiv“ mit 36,00 € Jahresbei: Example: “Passive” with an annual fee of €36.00 instead of €72.00 for “Active”: whoever no longer takes an active part pays half.
Kennzeichen einer Mitgliedsart: aktive M: Property of a membership type: active members take full part in club life, passive members mainly support with their fee. What this means for rights and fee is governed by the constitution (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: 112 aktive und 38 passive Mitg: Example: 112 active and 38 passive members: the umbrella association calculates its fee separately for both groups.
Summe der Zeiten, in denen jemand Mitgli: Total of the periods in which someone was a member, without gaps between leaving and rejoining. Only membership types marked “counts towards duration” count (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: 1998 bis 2010 und wieder ab 20: Example: 1998 to 2010 and again from 2014 gives 24 years in total in 2026; the 25-year anniversary follows in 2027.
Nummer, unter der der Dachverband ein Mi: Number under which the umbrella association lists a member, so that reports and honours are assigned unambiguously. It is part of the data that goes to the umbrella association (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR).
Beispiel: Verbandsnr. 1920-0457: dasselb: Example: association no. 1920-0457: the same member, even if they change platoon.
Der Tag, für den ein Stand gezählt oder: The day for which a figure is counted or calculated, e.g. members, age or account balance. Whoever is a member on that day counts (§ 259(1) BGB).
Beispiel: Stichtag 1. Januar 2026, 150 M: Example: cut-off date 1 January 2026, 150 members: whoever joins on 2 January only counts at the next cut-off date.
Erzeugt die Beitragsrechnungen für einen: Creates the fee invoices for a period all at once, according to each member's fee rules. The basis is the obligation to pay fees under the constitution or fee regulations (§ 58 no. 2 BGB).
Beispiel: Beitragslauf 2026 mit 142 Rech: Example: fee run 2026 with 142 invoices totalling €9,360.00: one click instead of 142 separate invoices.
Eine Rechnung an eine Untereinheit, die: One invoice to a sub-unit that pays its members' fees collectively instead of each member individually. The sub-unit then collects the fees itself (§ 58 no. 2 BGB).
Beispiel: Sammelrechnung Jägerzug: 18 Mi: Example: collective invoice Jägerzug: 18 members, €1,296.00: the platoon transfers one amount for everyone.
Ab der Fälligkeit darf der Verein die Za: From the due date the club may demand payment; it results from invoice date and payment term. At the latest 30 days later a member is in default if the invoice points this out (§§ 271, 286(3) BGB).
Beispiel: Rechnung vom 1. März, Zahlungs: Example: invoice dated 1 March, payment term 14 days, so due on 15 March.
Der Teil einer Rechnung, der noch nicht: The part of an invoice not yet paid: invoice amount minus all recorded payments. The member still owes this remainder (§ 362(1) BGB).
Beispiel: Rechnung 72,00 €, gezahlt 36,0: Example: invoice €72.00, paid €36.00, open €36.00: half is still missing.
Eine Rechnung, deren Fälligkeit vorbei i: An invoice whose due date has passed and on which something is still open. Whether the member is already in default also depends on a reminder or a note on the invoice (§ 286 BGB).
Beispiel: 9 von 142 Rechnungen überfälli: Example: 9 of 142 invoices overdue, together €648.00: time for the reminder.
Stufe im Mahnablauf, die eine bestimmte: Step in the reminder process reached a certain number of days after the due date, with its own text and possibly a charge. With the first reminder after the due date the member is in default (§ 286(1) BGB).
Beispiel: Erinnerung nach 14 Tagen ohne: Example: payment reminder after 14 days without charge, 1st reminder after 28 days with €2.50 postage.
Die Erlaubnis des Zahlers, dass der Vere: The payer's permission for the club to collect amounts from their account, and at the same time the instruction to their bank to honour the direct debit (EPC016-06). Without a valid mandate the club may not collect (§ 675j(1) BGB).
Beispiel: 104 von 142 Mitgliedern haben: Example: 104 of 142 members have granted a mandate: their fee arrives without a transfer.
Eindeutige Kennung eines Mandats beim Ve: Unique identifier of a mandate at the club, up to 35 characters. It appears on every direct debit and pre-notification so that the payer can match it (EPC016-06).
Beispiel: Mandatsreferenz M-0042: Auf de: Example: mandate reference M-0042: on the bank statement the member recognises which mandate the collection belongs to.
Die Gläubiger-Identifikationsnummer kenn: The creditor identifier marks the club as a submitter of direct debits; in Germany the Bundesbank issues it on application. Together with the mandate reference it makes every mandate unique (Bundesbank, EPC016-06).
Beispiel: DE98ZZZ09999999999: Das „DE“ s: Example: DE98ZZZ09999999999: “DE” stands for Germany, “ZZZ” is a fixed placeholder.
Mitteilung an den Zahler über Betrag und: Notice to the payer of the amount and date of a collection, 14 calendar days in advance unless otherwise agreed (EPC016-06). It can also be on the invoice or apply once for several identical collections.
Beispiel: Einzug am 15. März, Ankündigun: Example: collection on 15 March, notice by 1 March at the latest: the member can make sure the account is in funds.
Ein Mandat verfällt, wenn 36 Monate lang: A mandate expires if no direct debit has been collected on it for 36 months. After that a new mandate is needed (EPC016-06).
Beispiel: letzter Einzug im Mai 2023, da: Example: last collection in May 2023, then expired in May 2026: the member must sign again for the next fee.
Die IBAN ist die internationale Kontonum: The IBAN is the international account number, 22 characters in Germany; the BIC identifies the bank and is no longer needed for payments within the SEPA area. A check digit in the IBAN catches most typing errors (EPC016-06).
Beispiel: DE02 1203 0000 0000 2020 51: „: Example: DE02 1203 0000 0000 2020 51: “DE” for Germany, “02” is the check digit.
Die XML-Datei mit allen Lastschriften ei: The XML file with all direct debits of a run, which you upload in online banking. Its format is set by the SEPA rulebook; the bank then collects the amounts (EPC016-06).
Beispiel: eine Datei mit 104 Lastschrift: Example: one file with 104 direct debits totalling €7,488.00: upload once instead of 104 separate orders.
Geld auf einem Konto oder in der Barkass: Money in an account or the cash box at the start of the period, usually the previous year's closing balance. It is the starting point of every cash calculation (§ 259(1) BGB).
Beispiel: Anfangsbestand 4.250,00 € am 1: Example: opening balance €4,250.00 on 1 January: this much was in the current account before the year began.
Geld auf einem Konto am Ende des Zeitrau: Money in an account at the end of the period: opening balance plus income minus expenses, plus or minus transfers. It must match the bank statement (§ 259(1) BGB).
Beispiel: 4.250,00 € + 9.800,00 € − 8.90: Example: €4,250.00 + €9,800.00 − €8,900.00 = €5,150.00: the bank statement for 31 December shows the same amount.
Geld wandert zwischen zwei eigenen Konte: Money moves between two of your own accounts, for example from the cash box to the current account. It is neither income nor expense and does not change the result (§ 259(1) BGB).
Beispiel: 600,00 € Kasseneinnahmen vom F: Example: €600.00 cash takings from the festival paid into the current account: cash box −€600.00, current account +€600.00, result unchanged.
Differenz von Einnahmen und Ausgaben, et: Difference between income and expenses, for example per category. Positive means: more taken in than spent (§ 259(1) BGB).
Beispiel: Kategorie Schützenfest: Einnah: Example: category marksmen's festival: income €3,100.00, expenses €2,700.00, balance €400.00.
Alle Einnahmen minus alle Ausgaben eines: All income minus all expenses of a period or event, without transfers. A negative result means the club paid in from reserves or balances (§ 259(1) BGB).
Beispiel: Ergebnis 2026: +900,00 €: Der: Example: result 2026: +€900.00: the club took in €900.00 more than it spent during the year.
Nachweis zu einer Buchung, z. B. Rechnun: Evidence for an entry, e.g. invoice, receipt or bank statement. Accounting documents must be kept for eight years (§ 147(1) no. 4, (3) AO).
Beispiel: Buchung 2026-0117 „Getränke Fe: Example: entry 2026-0117 “Festival drinks” €412.30 with the scanned invoice from the drinks supplier.
Der Zeitraum, für den der Verein abrechn: The period for which the club accounts and presents a treasurer's report, usually the calendar year. The constitution can set a different year (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: Geschäftsjahr 1. Juli 2025 bis: Example: financial year 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026: the marksmen's festival in June falls at the end of the same year.
Zusammenstellung von Anfangs- und Endbes: Statement of opening and closing balance per account as well as income and expenses by category for a financial year. With it the board accounts to the general meeting (§ 27(3), §§ 666, 259 BGB).
Beispiel: Kassenbericht 2026 auf vier Se: Example: treasurer's report 2026 on four pages, signed by both cash auditors, is presented to the annual general meeting.
Von der Mitgliederversammlung gewählte M: Members elected by the general meeting who audit the treasury and report on it; the constitution sets their tasks. They are not part of the board they audit (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: zwei Kassenprüfer prüfen 312 B: Example: two cash auditors check 312 entries by sampling and recommend discharge.
Die eigentliche Vereinsarbeit für den Sa: The actual club work for the statutory purpose, financed mainly by fees and donations. For non-profit clubs this area is tax-free (§ 52 AO, § 5(1) no. 9 KStG).
Beispiel: Mitgliedsbeiträge 9.360,00 € u: Example: membership fees €9,360.00 and donations €800.00 belong to the non-profit sphere.
Einnahmen aus dem Vermögen des Vereins,: Income from the club's assets, such as interest or long-term letting, without its own business operation. For non-profit clubs it remains tax-free (§ 14 sentence 3 AO, § 5(1) no. 9 KStG).
Beispiel: 1.200,00 € Pacht im Jahr für d: Example: €1,200.00 a year rent for the leased club restaurant.
Ein Geschäftsbetrieb, der den Satzungszw: A business operation that directly fulfils the statutory purpose and cannot be achieved otherwise. It remains tax-privileged like the non-profit sphere (§§ 64(1), 65 AO).
Beispiel: Eintritt zum Vereinswettbewerb: Example: entry fees for the club competition, €650.00: the event itself serves the club's purpose.
Eine selbstständige, nachhaltige Tätigke: An independent, ongoing activity by which the club earns income and that goes beyond asset management (§ 14 AO). Tax is only due when this income including VAT exceeds €50,000 a year (§ 64(3) AO).
Beispiel: Getränkeverkauf am Schützenfes: Example: drinks sales at the marksmen's festival, €14,000.00: taxable area, but below the threshold.
Steuer auf Lieferungen und Leistungen ge: Tax on supplies and services in return for payment, normally 19%, reduced 7% (§ 12 UStG). Genuine membership fees are not covered (UStAE 1.4).
Beispiel: Werbebande für 500,00 € netto,: Example: advertising board for €500.00 net, with 19% VAT €595.00 gross.
Steuernummer und Umsatzsteuer-Identifika: Tax number and VAT ID (Steuernummer, USt-IdNr.)
Die Steuernummer vergibt das Finanzamt,: The tax number is issued by the tax office, the VAT ID by the Federal Central Tax Office. One of them belongs on every invoice with VAT (§ 14(4) sentence 1 no. 2 UStG).
Beispiel: USt-IdNr. DE123456789: „DE“ un: Example: VAT ID DE123456789: “DE” and nine digits.
Die Personen, die den Verein gerichtlich: The persons who represent the club in and out of court; the constitution determines who belongs. They are entered in the register of associations (§§ 26, 64 BGB).
Beispiel: Laut Satzung vertreten 2 von 3: Example: according to the constitution, 2 of 3 board members represent jointly; the 7 assessors of the extended board do not.
Registergericht und Registernummer: Register court and register number (Registergericht, Registernummer)
Ein eingetragener Verein steht im Verein: A registered association is entered in the register of associations at the local court, under a number with “VR”. Both belong in the legal notice (§ 21 BGB, § 5(1) no. 4 DDG).
Zeit nach dem Austritt, nach der HUBIpla: Time after leaving after which HUBIplan reduces a member's data to a minimum. Personal data may only be stored as long as necessary for the purpose (Art. 5(1)(e) GDPR).
Beispiel: Austritt am 31. Dezember 2025,: Example: left on 31 December 2025, period 24 months: from January 2028 only name, date of birth and periods remain.
Freiwillige, informierte Zustimmung eine: A person's voluntary, informed agreement to a specific processing of their data, e.g. for a photo. It can be withdrawn at any time (Art. 6(1)(a), Art. 7 GDPR).
Beispiel: Einwilligung am 12. März ertei: Example: consent given on 12 March, withdrawn on 2 May: from 2 May the photo no longer appears.
Ein Mitglied kann Informationsmails wie: A member can unsubscribe from information emails such as circulars; HUBIplan then no longer sends them by email. An objection to advertising by email is possible at any time (Art. 21(2) and (3) GDPR).
Beispiel: 6 von 120 Mitgliedern haben ab: Example: 6 of 120 members have unsubscribed: the circular goes to 114 addresses.
Bescheinigung des Vereins über eine Spen: Certificate from the club for a donation or a deductible fee, following the official template; only with it can the donor deduct the amount from tax (§ 10b(1) EStG, § 50(1) EStDV). Colloquially called Spendenquittung.
Beispiel: Frau Muster spendet im Jahr 3: Example: Ms Muster donates 3 × €50 during the year: in January she receives a collective receipt for €150.
Bescheid des Finanzamts, dass der Verein: Notice from the tax office that the club is exempt from corporation tax because of its non-profit status, usually as an annex to the corporation tax notice (§ 5(1) no. 9 KStG). It comes after the tax return, usually every three years.
Beispiel: Bescheid vom 14. März 2024 übe: Example: notice of 14 March 2024 for the years 2021 to 2023: receipts are possible until 14 March 2029.
Bescheid, dass die Satzung die Vorausset: Notice that the constitution meets the requirements for non-profit status (§ 60a AO). Newly founded clubs receive it before there is a first exemption notice.
Beispiel: Feststellung vom 2. Mai 2025:: Example: determination of 2 May 2025: HUBIplan issues receipts until 2 May 2028.
Bis 300 € genügt dem Spender statt einer: Up to €300 the bank statement is enough for the donor instead of a donation receipt, if they also keep a document from the club with the purpose and details of the tax exemption (§ 50(4) sentence 1 no. 2(b) EStDV). The club may still issue a receipt.
Beispiel: 50 € Spende per Überweisung: K: Example: €50 donation by transfer: the bank statement and the donation slip from the club booklet are enough.
Jemand verzichtet auf die Erstattung von: Someone waives reimbursement of expenses that the club owes them; the waiver then counts as a monetary donation (§ 10b(3) sentences 5 and 6 EStG).
Beispiel: 120 km Fahrt zum Verbandstag z: Example: 120 km trip to the association conference at €0.30 under the travel expense rule, so €36, and the treasurer confirms €36 as a donation.
Schriftliche Bestätigung, dass Geld empf: Written confirmation that money was received; whoever receives money must issue it on request (§ 368 BGB). For the treasury it is also the document for the entry.
Beispiel: Ein Mitglied zahlt 40 € Beitra: Example: a member pays a €40 fee in cash at the marksmen's festival and gets receipt Q-2026-0012.
Kontoauszug als Datei im Format camt.053: Bank statement as a file in camt.053 format under ISO 20022, offered by almost every online banking system; unlike a CSV file it contains unambiguous details such as IBAN, reference and closing balance.
Beispiel: Auszug Oktober mit 37 Umsätzen: Example: October statement with 37 transactions and closing balance €4,812.55 as an XML file.
Lastschrift, die zurückkommt, etwa weil: A direct debit that comes back, for example because the account has insufficient funds or the member objects; a member can object to an authorised direct debit up to eight weeks after the debit (§ 675x(2) and (4) BGB, EPC rulebook). Bank charges are often added.
Example: €60 fee collected on 1 March, returned on 6 March with reason “AM04” (insufficient funds) and a €3 charge.
Pflichtangaben zum Anbieter einer Websei: Mandatory information about the provider of a website: name, address, authorised representatives, contact and, if registered, register and number (§ 5 DDG). It must be easy to reach from every page.
Beispiel: Ein Link „Impressum“ im Fuß je: Example: an “Impressum” link in the footer of every page, no more than 2 clicks away.
Verantwortlich für den Inhalt: Responsible for the content (Verantwortlich für den Inhalt)
Person, die für journalistisch-redaktion: Person who takes responsibility for journalistic and editorial content such as reports and news, with name and address (§ 18(2) MStV). Usually the chair or the press officer.
Example: “Responsible under § 18(2) MStV: Erika Muster, Hauptstraße 1, 41468 Neuss”.
Rechnung in einem strukturierten Datenfo: Invoice in a structured data format (XRechnung or ZUGFeRD) that a program can read; a PDF alone is not an e-invoice (§ 14(1) UStG). Since 2025 every business must be able to receive them, including a club with a commercial operation.
Beispiel: Die Brauerei schickt Rechnung: Example: the brewery sends invoice RE-2026-0815 for €1,190.00 as an XML file; HUBIplan reads amount and date and keeps the file as a document.
Zählen des Bargelds und Vergleich mit de: Counting the cash and comparing it with the balance in the cash book. The cash box must be verifiable like this at any time (§ 146(1) AO).
Beispiel: Gezählt 412,30 €, laut Kassenb: Example: counted €412.30, cash book €415.00: the difference of €2.70 is booked with a reason.
Bargeldkasse ohne Registrierkasse, etwa: Cash box without a cash register, for example at the drinks stand; the day's takings are worked back at the end from the counted balance (§ 146(1) AO). This requires a count record.
Beispiel: Endbestand 1.850,00 €, Wechsel: Example: closing balance €1,850.00, float €200.00, ice cream paid in cash €50.00: day's takings €1,700.00.
Teil der Mittel, den der Verein für eine: Part of the funds that the club sets aside for a purpose without moving money (§ 62 AO). It is then no longer freely available.
Beispiel: 3.000,00 € von 8.000,00 € auf: Example: €3,000.00 of €8,000.00 in the accounts are tied up as “Reserve marquee”; €5,000.00 is freely available.
Das Finanzamt darf bei einer Prüfung die: In an audit the tax office may demand the accounts as machine-readable files (§ 147(6) AO). The data export provides all tables, documents and a description (index.xml) for this.
Beispiel: Für die Prüfung 2025 lädt der: Example: for the 2025 audit the treasurer downloads “Kasse-2025-Export.zip” and gives the file to the auditor on a USB stick.
Zeit, in der Kassenunterlagen aufbewahrt: Time for which treasury records must be kept: documents 8 years, books and closings 10 years, each from the end of the calendar year (§ 147(3) and (4) AO).
Beispiel: Belege aus 2025 dürfen ab dem: Example: documents from 2025 may be deleted from 1 Jan 2034, the 2025 entries anonymised from 1 Jan 2036.
Jeder Eintrag im Änderungsprotokoll enth: Every entry in the change log contains a checksum of its predecessor; if one is changed or deleted, the chain no longer fits. This keeps it provable that changes were not suppressed (§ 146(4) AO, GoBD).
Beispiel: Eintrag Nr. 1205 verweist auf: Example: entry no. 1205 refers to the checksum of no. 1204; if no. 1204 is missing, the daily check reports “no. 1204 to 1204 missing”.
Zusätzliches Schießen bei Gleichstand au: Additional shooting in case of a tie on a prize place, with its own rules for number of shots and scoring. If it is tied again afterwards, another shoot-off follows; the rules are in the shooting rules or the DSB sport regulations.
Beispiel: Anna und Paul haben beide 28 R: Example: Anna and Paul both have 28 rings for 1st place; in a 1-shot shoot-off Anna scores 9, Paul 8, Anna comes first.
Jeder Schuss zählt mit einer Nachkommast: Every shot counts with one decimal place, the closer to the centre the higher, on the air rifle at most 10.9 (DSB sport regulations). This makes ties much rarer than with whole rings.
Beispiel: Ein Treffer 0,8 mm neben der M: Example: a hit 0.8 mm from the centre of the DSB air rifle target counts 10.6, one 3 mm off 9.8.
Besonders guter Zehner: Auf der DSB-Luft: A particularly good ten: on the DSB air rifle target it is one that shoots away the white ten dot completely (DSB sport regulations). More inner tens often decide a tie.
Beispiel: Ein Treffer 0,8 mm neben der M: Example: a hit 0.8 mm from the centre is an inner ten, one 2 mm off only a ten.
Abstand der Trefferlochmitte zur Scheibe: Distance of the centre of the hole from the centre of the target in hundredths of a millimetre; smaller is better (DSB sport regulations, with a factor for some targets). In a Teiler shoot the best single shot wins.
Beispiel: Ein Loch, dessen Mitte 0,8 mm: Example: a hole whose centre is 0.8 mm from the centre of the target has the Teiler 80; Teiler 80 beats Teiler 120.
Der schwarze Kreis in der Mitte der Sche: The black circle in the middle of the target that is aimed at; a card has one or more bullseyes (DSB sport regulations). Photo recognition first looks for the bullseye and then aligns the image.
Beispiel: Der Spiegel der DSB-Luftgewehr: Example: the bullseye of the DSB air rifle target measures 30.5 mm and reaches from the 4 ring to the ten.
Mehrere Schüsse liegen so dicht, dass ih: Several shots are so close that their holes merge; then the outline does not reliably show where each hole is. Every shot is still scored by its hole edge (DSB sport regulations), which is why photo recognition says “please check”.
Beispiel: 5 Schuss in einen Spiegel erge: Example: 5 shots in one bullseye give a single, jagged hole about the size of 2 separate holes.
Zwei oder mehr Schützen haben denselben: Two or more marksmen have the same score. They share the place; on prize places a shoot-off decides (club shooting rules, DSB sport regulations).
Beispiel: Zweimal 27 Ringe ergibt zweima: Example: two scores of 27 rings give 2nd place twice; the next marksman is fourth.
Platz, für den es laut Ausschreibung ein: Place for which there is a prize according to the call for entries, for example the first three. Only here does a tie need a shoot-off (§ 661 BGB).
Beispiel: Bei 3 Preisplätzen muss ein Gl: Example: with 3 prize places, a tie for 3rd place must be shot off, one for 4th place not.
Die Schüsse, deren Ringe in den Wert ein: The shots whose rings count towards the score; the others are sighting or dropped shots. How many count is set by the club's shooting rules or the DSB sport regulations.
Beispiel: 5 Schuss, davon 3 gewertet: We: Example: 5 shots, 3 of them scored: whoever shoots 9, 10, 8, 10, 7 has 29 rings with the best three, if the rules count the best.
Wertung der Züge oder Abteilungen aus de: Ranking of platoons or departments from the individual results of their marksmen, for example as the sum of the best 5 (platoon ranking). Units with too few marksmen remain unranked, as with teams under the DSB sport regulations.
Beispiel: Zug 1 mit 28, 27, 25, 24, 22 u: Example: platoon 1 with 28, 27, 25, 24, 22 and 20 rings has 126 rings with “best 5”.
Der Schütze schießt mit und erscheint in: The marksman takes part and appears in the list but gets no place and no prize. Common for range officers or guests from neighbouring clubs (§ 25 BGB, shooting rules).
Beispiel: Der Schießleiter schießt 30 Ri: Example: the range officer shoots 30 rings hors concours; 1st place goes to the best with 28.
Teilnehmer, der nicht Mitglied ist; von: Participant who is not a member; HUBIplan only stores name and club for them (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR). Whether guests may shoot for prizes is set by the call for entries.
Beispiel: „Gerd Gast, SV Nachbarort“ sch: Example: “Gerd Gast, SV Nachbarort” shoots 26 rings; for the platoon ranking he can be assigned to a sub-unit.
Nummer aus dem Hut, die beim Vogelschieß: Number from the hat that sets the order of marksmen in the bird shoot. Latecomers draw a number still free; the procedure is governed by the shooting rules (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: Wer Los 7 zieht, schießt nach: Example: whoever draws lot 7 shoots after number 6 and before number 8.
Teil des Vogels, für dessen Abschuss es: Part of the bird for whose shooting down there is a prize, such as head, wing or tail. Whoever brings it down has won the prize piece; prize pieces and prizes are set by the shooting rules (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: Paul holt mit Schuss 54 den li: Example: Paul brings down the left wing with shot 54 and receives the wing medal.
Ein Durchgang durch alle Losnummern; dan: One pass through all lot numbers; after that the next round starts again at the lowest number. Absentees and those eliminated are skipped (shooting rules, § 25 BGB).
Beispiel: Bei 40 Schützen beginnt mit de: Example: with 40 marksmen the second round starts with the 41st shot.
Schüsse für das Pfand: Shots for the prize piece (Schüsse für das Pfand)
Schüsse seit dem vorher gefallenen Pfand: Shots since the previously fallen prize piece up to the one that brought down this prize piece. For the first prize piece all shots since the start count; what prizes exist for is governed by the shooting rules (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: Der Kopf fällt mit Schuss 30,: Example: the head falls with shot 30, the tail with shot 75: for the tail it took 45 shots.
Zustand nach „Schießen beenden“: Ergebni: Status after “Finish shooting”: results are in, additions and shoot-offs are still possible. Lists carry the note “provisional” so that nobody takes them as final (Art. 5(1)(d) GDPR).
Beispiel: Am Abend hängt die vorläufige: Example: in the evening the provisional list is put up; a shoot-off the next morning still changes 3rd place.
Zustand nach dem Abschluss: Eingaben sin: Status after closing: entries are locked, the results stand. Only final results are intended for the website and honours (Art. 5(1)(d) GDPR).
Beispiel: Nach dem 2. Stechen schließt d: Example: after the 2nd shoot-off the shooting master closes the competition; after that no score can be changed.
Vollbildansicht für Tablet oder Handy am: Full-screen view for a tablet or phone at the range, with large search and input; it keeps working without reception. It only shows what is needed for recording (Art. 5(1)(c) GDPR) and sends as soon as there is a connection again.
Beispiel: Am Stand tippt die Aufsicht „M: Example: at the range the supervisor types “Mül”, chooses Jürgen Müller and enters 27.
Zugang per QR-Code für ein Gerät ohne An: Access via QR code for a device without signing in, only for this competition and until the end of the competition day (Art. 32 GDPR).
Beispiel: Das Leihtablet „Stand 2“ scann: Example: the borrowed tablet “Range 2” scans the code and can record until 23:59.
Verein oder Verband, der einen fremden W: Club or association that holds and scores an external competition. It sets rules and prizes (§ 25 BGB).
Beispiel: Beim Bezirksschießen 2027 ist: Example: at the district shoot 2027 the district association is the organiser; you only enter your places, for example 3rd place with 287 rings.
Ausgangspunkt ist der Jahresbeitrag der: The starting point is the annual fee of the membership type; if an age band applies by age at the start of the financial year, it replaces it. An honour with a fee adjustment lowers it further; with several, the most favourable applies. Fees and reductions follow the constitution or fee regulations (§ 58 no. 2 BGB); whoever was born on 29 February only gets older on 1 March in years without a leap day.
Der Beitrag des Zeitraums wird durch des: The fee for the period is divided by its months and multiplied by the months of membership, where a started month counts in full, and rounded commercially to the cent. With several instalments a year, leftover cents go to the first instalments so that together they make exactly the annual fee (€100.00 monthly: 4 × €8.34 and 8 × €8.33).
Gezählt werden die gemeldeten Mitglieder: The reported members of each club are counted at the start of the period, separately for active and passive. Each group is multiplied by its rate per member and calculated pro rata for the period (§ 58 no. 2 BGB).
Heute plus die eingestellte Vorabankündi: Today plus the set pre-notification period, but at least two days, moved to the next working day. The SEPA rulebook requires the notice before collection (EPC016-06).
Ab dem letzten Einzug, oder ohne Einzug: From the last collection, or without a collection from the signature, 36 months are counted. If nothing has been collected by then, the mandate counts as expired (EPC016-06).
Jede Stufe nennt die Tage nach Fälligkei: Each level states the days after the due date from which it applies. Under “Reminders due” HUBIplan suggests the next level reached for each open invoice; a charge is added as a separate item (§ 286 BGB).
Endbestand = Anfangsbestand + Einnahmen: Closing balance = opening balance + income − expenses ± transfers, per account. The sum of all closing balances must match bank statements and the cash box (§ 259(1) BGB). “Balance today” only includes entries up to today; later ones are shown alongside as pending.
Mitglied am Stichtag ist, wessen Mitglie: A member on the cut-off date is anyone whose membership runs on that day; the figure for a day is the state after that day's leavings. Joinings and leavings count every change in the chosen period, so a rejoining counts again as a joining.
Zusammengezählt werden alle Zeiten der M: All periods of membership in types that count towards duration are added up; gaps between leaving and rejoining do not count, overlapping periods only once. If the total reaches a round number this year, the anniversary appears.
Jede Einheit kann Untereinheiten haben,: Every unit can have sub-units, which may in turn have their own, for example club, platoon and group. If you move a unit, its sub-units and members move with it. Without “manages itself” the unit above manages everything; when switched on, its role holders work with their own accounts, and with its own workspace it also keeps its own treasury.
Zuerst sucht HUBIplan eine passende Buch: First HUBIplan looks for a matching entry in the cash book (same amount, ±3 days), then a direct debit run of the same amount (±10 days), then an invoice via the number in the reference or the IBAN of a mandate. You apply the suggestion, book with a category or skip the transaction. HUBIplan recognises a second import of the same transactions and creates nothing twice.
Eine Seite bietet die Kopplung an, die a: One side offers the link, the other accepts it with the code; compare the fingerprint by phone so that nobody gets in between. After that only the data each side releases flows, encrypted and signed. A link can be paused and ended; the data on your own instance remains.
Der QR-Code gilt nur kurz und nur einmal: The QR code is only valid briefly and once; when scanning, the phone gets its own key, and no password is stored. Under “Signed-in devices” you see every phone and sign it out, for example if it is lost. After that the app stops working there immediately.
Mit Ordnungszahl zählt HUBIplan je Würde: With ordinal numbers HUBIplan counts per title and first name: the first Michael is Michael I, the next Michael II. If someone holds the title twice, they keep their number unless “count anew for repeated titles” is on. A number from old lists is entered directly on the reign and takes precedence.
Tageseinnahme im Kassenbericht: Day's takings in the treasurer's report
Tageseinnahme = gezählter Endbestand − A: Day's takings = counted closing balance − opening balance (float) + expenses paid in cash + withdrawals. You book expenses and withdrawals individually as usual; HUBIplan only books the takings, split across the categories.
Frei verfügbar = Bestand aller Konten he: Freely available = balance of all accounts today − sum of all reserves. If the value is negative, more funds are tied up than exist; then release reserves.
Plätze bei Gleichstand: Places in case of a tie
Gleiche Werte teilen sich den Platz, der: Equal scores share the place; the next place is skipped. On prize places a shoot-off decides, after which the order of the shoot-off applies.
Vom Trefferpunkt zu Ring, Zehntel und Te: From hit position to ring, tenth and Teiler
Zehntel = höchster Ring + (halbe Zehn +: Tenths = highest ring + (half ten + half calibre − distance from centre) ÷ ring width, rounded down to one tenth and at most 10.9; the ring is the whole part of it. That way, as in the sport regulations, the higher ring counts as soon as the hole edge touches the ring line. The Teiler is the distance in hundredths of a millimetre.
Bei „Summe der besten k“ zählen die k be: With “sum of the best k”, the k best individual scores of the unit count; marksmen hors concours do not count. If a unit has fewer than k scores, it gets no place.
Geschossen wird nach Losnummer, Fehlende: Shooting follows the lot number; absentees and those eliminated are skipped. After the highest number the next round starts again at the lowest.
Gezählt werden die Schüsse seit dem vorh: The shots since the previously fallen prize piece up to the hit are counted.
Alle Geräte gleichen sich etwa alle 3 Se: All devices sync about every 3 seconds; for a marksman the last value entered applies, and marksmen created twice are merged. Without reception recording continues and is sent later. Creating and closing shoot-offs needs reception.
